$comment: ProSlot Canonical Role Registry — machine-readable twin of the ratified registry document (23 Aug 2026). Single source for the conformance scanner, API test matrix, site harnesses, and the shape repair. Grant models: DEFAULT (assigned by auto-join at signup/sign-in), PICK (user selects during signup/onboarding), ASSIGNED (admin panels only — must never be reachable via self-registration).

FACILITY_OWNER.meaning: Facility owner variant (HomeTeam lineage); fold-into-OWNER candidate

SPORTSORG.meaning: Partner sports organisation; canonical for now, phase-out later

TRAINER.meaning: Session trainer — distinct job from COACH; never a signup default (decision 2026-08-23)

USER.meaning: Default/unassigned; only legitimate root role for non-platform accounts

PLATFORM_ADMIN.meaning: Platform infrastructure role enforced in firestore.rules and API middleware — discovered by the scanner's first run; platform scope, not an org role

$aliasComment: Plus case-insensitive matching: any casing of a canonical role repairs to its exact spelling. 'tutor' is demo-site residue, mapped to USER by the shape repair.
$guestComment: GUEST appears in site type unions as a client-side unauthenticated state; it is never stored and is not a registry role.

organizations.reason: legacy orgId string array; organizationIds is the authority

athletes.reason: third variant of the same concept

coParentEmail.reason: email-keyed variant; resolve to uid where possible, else keep raw in array

membershipTier.reason: tier travels with the membership record

familyIds.reason: per-org map collapses where single-valued; conflicts flagged, never chosen silently

displayName.reason: split into firstName/lastName only when both are empty; otherwise flagged

underReview.CEO: appears in 9 API privilege lists (bookingRoutes) — likely legacy; consolidate into OWNER or delete
underReview.SPORTSORG_OWNER: league admin variant accepted alongside SPORTSORG — collapse
underReview.assistant: BoysOfSummer sports-org member sub-roles — a DIFFERENT domain (org membership), not user org roles; needs domain separation in the scanner
underReview.SYSTEM_ADMIN: internal impersonation marker + sso privileged list — consolidate into PLATFORM_ADMIN
underReview.SUPERADMIN: bos invoiceRoutes checks — consolidate into PLATFORM_ADMIN
underReview.SPORTS_ORG: underscore variant accepted in communicationRoutes — collapse into SPORTSORG
underReview.STAFF: legacy member of userRoutes VALID_ROLES and one privilege check; zero stored
underReview.TEACHER: education module (demo lineage, same as 'tutor'); requireRole list only
underReview.GUARDIAN: familyRoutes FAMILY-member role — a different domain from org roles; needs domain separation

$underReviewComment: Literals the scanner found in production code that are neither canonical nor aliased. Reported as WARN, not ERROR, until each gets a decision.

athleteShape.$comment: Athlete-record spec (root `athletes` collection), from the 23 Aug inventory of all 842 docs. Same convergence rules as the user shape: writers born conformant, lazy repair folds-never-drops, conflicts flagged not chosen.

studentOnly.$comment: STUDENT-record fields ONLY. athleteRoutes writes them as null scaffolding on EVERY athlete (268 baseball athletes carry them empty; 2 docs have real values). Writer must conditionalize; repair deletes null-only scaffolding from non-student records and flags populated ones.

birthday.$comment: Formats are already uniform (556 YYYY-MM-DD, 1 stray). The split is the FIELD NAME: birthday(557) vs dateOfBirth(246), 145 docs carry both — 127 agree (fold), 18 CONFLICT with wildly different dates (looks like parent-vs-child DOB mixups; flagged for review, never auto-picked). Consumers overwhelmingly read `birthday`.

userId.reason: 125 docs; linkage concept — spec in step 3

parentFirstName.reason: denormalized parent data (23); parent doc is the authority

_testMode.reason: 21 TEST DOCS IN PRODUCTION — review for deletion with _testBatchId

dualStore.$comment: Athletes exist in root (842) AND per-org subcollections (~358 across 5 orgs: hometeamsports 188, eccbaseballny 54, ProSlotTrainingFacility 52, griffsmethod 42, newyorkhittersclub 22). Drift unmeasured. Portability goal implies root as source of truth with subcollections as projections or retired — decision + drift audit scheduled for step 3.
